q1_issues.issue: The definite plural subject 'the villagers' with the distributive predicate 'say' gets the group event but not the paired per-member distribution rule over (PartOf $x sk_villagers_1), so a villager named later could not be queried as a sayer — the very rule the parse does emit for the lanterns inside the seal.

notes: Non-factive 'say' with an Experiencer holder, no predication of P at top level, the definite plural's GroupOf typing projected out of the seal, deontic Obligated on the specific referents rather than a kind-level property, and the sealed per-member rule as a conjunct of P are all as specified. The sealed Implication carries no STV of its own, which is the registered in-seal-grammar limitation rather than a parse defect.
